shared_elements: low relief carving with incised interior detail
patterned/striated infill on garments or animal fleece
head with elaborate hair or headdress
justification: Both surfaces show a human head and shoulders in strict profile rendered in low relief with incised linear detail and striated infill (fleece in A, garment/plumage-like bands in B), which is a broad shared convention rather than a specific motif. A is a multi-figure procession of attendants leading horned rams beside a tree along a bordered frieze, while B is a single isolated bust-length figure with a beaked or masked face and no accompanying animals, scene or ground line.
